source.title: Call For Applicants - WEAT Members (April 2022)
source.content:
The **WCA Executive Assistants Team** is seeking new members!

The WCA Executive Assistants Team (WEAT) is a team that assists the WCA Board with administrative tasks. The rights and duties of the WEAT can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.5%20-%20Executive%20Assistants%20Team.pdf).
<!-- break -->
The following are the expected requirements for applicant:

* Commitment of approximately 2-4 hours per week
* Strong organizational skills
* Good communication skills
* Trustworthiness

The candidacy documents must be in **PDF format**, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA Community.
* Reasons you are fit for the role.

Applications should be sent to [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org) from now until **May 16th, 2022, 23:59 UTC** to be considered.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 执行助理团队成员（2022 年 4 月）
translation.content:
**WCA 执行助理团队**正在招募新成员！

WCA 执行助理团队（WEAT）协助 WCA 董事会处理行政事务。WEAT 的权利与职责可在[这里](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.5%20-%20Executive%20Assistants%20Team.pdf)查看。

我们希望申请者具备以下条件：

* 每周可投入约 2–4 小时。
* 较强的组织能力。
* 良好的沟通能力。
* 值得信赖。

申请材料须为 **PDF 格式**，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 曾为 WCA 社区开展的工作概述。
* 你适合这一职位的理由。

请于即日起至 **2022 年 5 月 16 日 23:59 UTC**，将申请发送至 [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)。
